name: Grand Rush VR: Highway Racing Simulator
summary:
Welcome to Grand Rush VR : Highway Racing Simulator! Experience the thrill of high-speed adventures across four unique locations:
-Desert: Feel the dust and heat as you race across sandy dunes.
-Winter: Conquer snowy tracks and icy roads, facing natural challenges.
-Forest: Maneuver through dense trees and complex forest trails.
-City: Navigate urban life, speeding through interchanges and narrow streets.

Start your journey with a classic Japanese car and advance to hypercars reaching over four hundred km/
